rows.text: Since you've helped so much already, it's time I spoke plainly with you.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: In the Era Bellica, there was a prophetess named Kuma. I encountered her a few times. She never abused prophecy for personal gain, yet she was branded a heretic. Her works were all destroyed, and even her name was erased.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: It's said that she preserved her research in ways unknown and scattered it across Amphoreus. These slates may be her handiwork... but certain details remain unexplained.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: To my knowledge, she was not of the Chrysos Heirs, and her soul has long since fallen into the embrace of Thanatos.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The content of these slates is of little significance to me — other than following the prophecy and hunting for the Coreflames, there are no other means to save Amphoreus. However, the method by which these ancient relics have been preserved intrigues me.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Thanks to prior studies, I have a few preliminary insights, but I need to unlock more fragments to verify them. I'll need your help with that, dear guest.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: A fascinating question, esteemed guest. First, I should point out that prophecies don't only show the future — they can also offer clues and reveal hidden truths.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The priests of Oronyx use prophecies to locate lost things, those of Janus use them to navigate mazes, and those of Talanton use them to prove innocence...
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: So you see, prophecies serve many purposes, but deciphering them isn't my main goal — it's just planting a seed for the future.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The nymphs themselves hold the most valuable power. Bringing them under my control matters more than interpreting any prophecy.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Look at these "romantic" butterflies — so charming yet so fragile... If I could choose, I'd rather be a beetle.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Thanks to the stone slates you collected earlier, the golden threads have pointed me in a clearer direction.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The owner of these slates, the prophetess named Kuma, did indeed commit a taboo: She tried to seize the authority of Romance to transform herself into a nymph and escape Thanatos's grasp.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
